anchors.statement: An sc-compose version upgrade run must complete without any step that waits for input from Rand Lee, the repository owner, other than his merges of the PRs to develop and main.
anchors.quote: I want upgrades of dependent libraries to be completed atonamously with no input from me.
anchors.scope: the upgrade-sc-compose formula (.atm-bd/formula/upgrade-sc-compose.formula.toml.j2) and every bead poured from it

pass: Every step of the formula is dispatched to an agent role (dev, qa, lead, publisher); decisions and stops are sent to omega-prime@hermes and no step waits for a reply from Rand.
fail: The release step pauses and asks Rand to confirm whether to cut a patch release before it continues.

history.previous_statement: An sc-compose version upgrade run (pin bump, tests, PRs) must complete without any step that waits for input from Rand Lee, the repository owner.

anchors.statement: An sc-compose version upgrade must change only the repository files that reference the sc-compose version or that the new version's changelog requires changing.
anchors.quote: the responsibliity is to make the 2-3 file changes necessary and be done
anchors.scope: the upgrade-sc-compose formula (.atm-bd/formula/upgrade-sc-compose.formula.toml.j2) and every bead poured from it

pass: Deliverable 1 bumps SC_COMPOSE_PIN in .claude/lib/sc_compose_dependency.py; deliverable 2 edits only the repo-owned files the changelog requires; owned_paths lists only these.
fail: The upgrade step also refactors the bead templates, rewrites the README and reorganises .claude/lib while bumping the pin.

anchors.statement: An sc-compose version upgrade must run the repository's test suite after its edits and record whether the tests pass.
anchors.quote: you are writing a formula that likely needs to edit 3-4 lines in the repo. and test that it works
anchors.scope: the upgrade-sc-compose formula (.atm-bd/formula/upgrade-sc-compose.formula.toml.j2) and every bead poured from it

pass: After the pin bump the dev runs just test and the pytest suites with the new sc-compose and records each test's pass/fail in the bead notes.
fail: The step bumps the pin and opens the PR; no tests are run against the new sc-compose version.

anchors.statement: An sc-compose version upgrade must not change any file under another skill's directory in .claude/skills/.
anchors.quote: we can not micromanage other skills.
anchors.scope: the upgrade-sc-compose formula (.atm-bd/formula/upgrade-sc-compose.formula.toml.j2) and every bead poured from it

pass: The upgrade step's owned_paths is only .claude/lib/sc_compose_dependency.py; it changes no file under another skill's directory in .claude/skills/, and a deprecation found in a skill-owned file is filed as an issue against that skill's repo instead.
fail: The upgrade step rewrites .claude/skills/atm-beads/templates/*.j2 to the new sc-compose syntax.

anchors.statement: The sc-compose version upgrade agent must read the sc-compose CHANGELOG.md or migration documentation for the new version before editing.
anchors.quote: the agent should read the change-log or other appropriate documentation.
anchors.scope: the upgrade-sc-compose formula (.atm-bd/formula/upgrade-sc-compose.formula.toml.j2) and every bead poured from it

pass: Deliverable 2 reads randlee/sc-compose CHANGELOG.md and docs/migration-notes.md at tag v<to_version> before any edit.
fail: The dev bumps the pin and runs tests; the sc-compose changelog is not consulted.

anchors.statement: For each deprecation or recommended change listed in the new sc-compose version's changelog, the upgrade agent must apply it or record why it does not apply.
anchors.quote: if there are recommended changes, deprrecations, those should be handled.
anchors.scope: the upgrade-sc-compose formula (.atm-bd/formula/upgrade-sc-compose.formula.toml.j2) and every bead poured from it

pass: Each deprecation and recommended change in the changelog is listed in the bead notes and either applied with the changed path or recorded as not used with the git grep that shows it.
fail: Deprecations listed in the sc-compose changelog are noted as out of scope and left for a later phase.

anchors.statement: An sc-compose version upgrade must execute only the steps poured from the upgrade-sc-compose formula, in their dependency order.
anchors.quote: The purpose of using a formula is to have the planning work done ahead of time.  we can directly build and execute the sprint steps in order.
anchors.scope: the upgrade-sc-compose formula (.atm-bd/formula/upgrade-sc-compose.formula.toml.j2) and every bead poured from it

pass: A run pours the formula with sc-compose bead attach and dispatches the poured beads as bd ready releases them along their needs edges; no new planning bead is created.
fail: After pouring, the lead writes a fresh sprint plan for the upgrade and adds new sprint beads before dispatching.

anchors.statement: When an sc-compose version upgrade has breaking changes, it must not open a release PR to main and must end with its PR to develop ready to merge.
anchors.quote: no if there are breaking changes, proceed with completing the work and STOP with pr ready to merge to develop AND an impace accessment.
anchors.summary: Breaking: stop at ready develop PR
anchors.scope: the upgrade-sc-compose formula (.atm-bd/formula/upgrade-sc-compose.formula.toml.j2) and every bead poured from it

pass: On a BREAKING verdict the pr_develop step leaves the develop PR ready to merge, closes the release bead as not planned and opens no PR to main.
fail: On a BREAKING verdict the run abandons the branch without opening a PR to develop.

anchors.statement: When an sc-compose upgrade has breaking changes, its PR to develop must include an impact assessment of those breaking changes.
anchors.quote: no if there are breaking changes, proceed with completing the work and STOP with pr ready to merge to develop AND an impace accessment.
anchors.scope: the upgrade-sc-compose formula (.atm-bd/formula/upgrade-sc-compose.formula.toml.j2) and every bead poured from it

pass: On a BREAKING verdict the PR to develop description lists the verdict, each failing test and each rendered diff as an impact assessment.
fail: On a BREAKING verdict the PR to develop is opened with only the pin change in its description.

anchors.statement: When no other work is in progress, an sc-compose version upgrade must end in a PR to main whose publish-preflight run passed.
anchors.quote: if there is NOT other work in progress, I expect this to end up in a pr to main that has passed publish-preflight and has a patch++ version bump ready to publish as soon as I approve the pr to main.
anchors.summary: No WIP: PR to main passed preflight
anchors.scope: the upgrade-sc-compose formula (.atm-bd/formula/upgrade-sc-compose.formula.toml.j2) and every bead poured from it

pass: With no other work in progress the publisher runs publish-preflight to GO and only then opens the develop -> main PR.
fail: With no other work in progress the publisher opens the PR to main and leaves publish-preflight for after Rand merges it.

anchors.statement: When no other work is in progress, the sc-compose version upgrade's PR to main must increase the patch version number.
anchors.quote: if there is NOT other work in progress, I expect this to end up in a pr to main that has passed publish-preflight and has a patch++ version bump ready to publish as soon as I approve the pr to main.
anchors.scope: the upgrade-sc-compose formula (.atm-bd/formula/upgrade-sc-compose.formula.toml.j2) and every bead poured from it

pass: With no other work in progress the publisher bumps the patch version (0.7.4 -> 0.7.5) before the PR to main.
fail: With no other work in progress the PR to main ships with the existing version number unchanged.

anchors.statement: Every decision point in the upgrade-sc-compose formula must contain an explicit `atm send omega-prime@hermes` instruction.
anchors.quote: at every decision point, there should be explicit instruction to send to omega-prime@hermes.
anchors.scope: the upgrade-sc-compose formula (.atm-bd/formula/upgrade-sc-compose.formula.toml.j2) and every bead poured from it

pass: Decision point 1 sends `atm send omega-prime@hermes` with the BREAKING or CI-green message; decision point 2 sends `atm send omega-prime@hermes` when the release is deferred.
fail: Decision point 2 checks for other work in progress and silently closes the release bead when release is deferred.

anchors.statement: Every escalation from an sc-compose version upgrade run must be sent with `atm send omega-prime@hermes`.
anchors.quote: Since the entire process will run unattended, all escelation will be to omega-prime@hermes
anchors.scope: the upgrade-sc-compose formula (.atm-bd/formula/upgrade-sc-compose.formula.toml.j2) and every bead poured from it

pass: If an environment will not install, the dev records the refusal and sends the reason with `atm send omega-prime@hermes`.
fail: If an environment will not install, the dev messages the team-lead and waits.

anchors.statement: When CI is green on an sc-compose version upgrade PR to develop or main, the agent must send `atm send omega-prime@hermes` a message asking Rand Lee to complete the PR.
anchors.quote: regarding protected branch merge to develop AND to master, when ci is green (after preflight and release-candidate tagging is done), notify omega-prime@hermes to notify me to complete the pr.
anchors.scope: the upgrade-sc-compose formula (.atm-bd/formula/upgrade-sc-compose.formula.toml.j2) and every bead poured from it

pass: When CI on the develop PR is green, the lead sends omega-prime@hermes "CI green. Rand, please complete <PR link>."
fail: When CI on the develop PR is green, the lead merges the PR to develop itself.

anchors.statement: Every PR to develop or main must have GitHub user rand-lee added as a reviewer.
anchors.quote: add github/rand-lee as reviewer for any pr to develop or main
anchors.scope: the upgrade-sc-compose formula (.atm-bd/formula/upgrade-sc-compose.formula.toml.j2) and every bead poured from it

pass: The develop PR is opened and rand-lee is added with gh api .../requested_reviewers -f 'reviewers[]=rand-lee'.
fail: The PR to main is opened with no reviewer requested.
